title: SvgClipPath
responsibility: Renders the native clipPath element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgClipPath.attributes
inputs.description: Native clipPath attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgClipPath.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native clipPath element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgClipPath
outputs.description: The actual native clipPath element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
